title: Letter and Portrait
author: Odile Hartwell
blurb: Petra Eastwick, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
